caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical container divided into two stacked sections, primarily colored in red with green and black accents. The container features two metal handles on each side, one on the upper cylinder and one on the lower cylinder. Both sections are decorated with gold-colored illustrations: the upper cylinder displays a stag standing on grass surrounded by stylized trees or branches, while the lower cylinder features a bird, possibly a duck or goose, amid foliage and geometric patterns. The upper section is capped with a round lid that has a loop handle at the top, surrounded by additional decorative patterns. The lower cylinder, tapering downward into a black base with gold detailing, has a metal spigot near the bottom. The name "Eugene Bartz" is written below the object. The background is plain and light-colored, and the image is centered and uncluttered, focusing solely on the container.
title: Portable Crock Filter
